name: The Denver Post editorial board
lean_basis: AllSides rates The Denver Post's online news Center (independent review, low or initial confidence, Oct. 2026) and Ad Fontes rates it Middle (-2.86). Neither rates the editorial board separately. Rating source: https://www.allsides.com/news-source/denver-post-media-bias.

name: The Gazette (Colorado Springs) editorial board
lean_basis: AllSides rates the Denver Gazette's online news Center (independent review, low or initial confidence, Oct. 2026) and does not rate the editorial board, which writes for both the Denver and Colorado Springs Gazettes. Rating source: https://www.allsides.com/news-source/denver-gazette-media-bias.

name: The Denver Gazette editorial board
lean_basis: AllSides rates the Denver Gazette's online news Center (independent review, low or initial confidence, Oct. 2026) and does not rate the editorial board, which writes for both the Denver and Colorado Springs Gazettes. Rating source: https://www.allsides.com/news-source/denver-gazette-media-bias.

name: The Colorado Sun
lean_basis: AllSides rates The Colorado Sun Lean Left (independent review, low or initial confidence, as of Oct. 2026). The nonprofit newsroom has no editorial board and does not endorse. Rating source: https://www.allsides.com/news-source/colorado-sun-media-bias.

name: League of Women Voters of Colorado (VOTE411)
lean_basis: League of Women Voters state chapter that describes the League as 'a nonpartisan, grassroots organization' (https://lwvcolorado.org/) and never endorses candidates. No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Colorado Democratic Party
lean_basis: Official state party organization. Its candidates page lists its nominees, and its State Central Committee voted positions on the 2026 statewide measures and Issue 7A.

name: Colorado Republican Party
lean_basis: Official state party organization; its candidates page lists its nominees. As of Oct 17, 2026 we found no state-party positions on the 2026 measures (the site blocks automated reads); see the Weld County GOP entry for a county-party proxy.

name: Colorado AFL-CIO
lean_basis: State labor federation whose stated focus is 'building power for working people and fighting for a fair and just economy for all' (https://coaflcio.org/about-us). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Colorado Education Association
lean_basis: Teachers' union that calls itself 'Colorado’s largest labor union' (https://www.coloradoea.org/about/). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Conservation Colorado
lean_basis: Environmental group that says 'We are in the fight to secure a healthy environment' (https://conservationco.org/). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Planned Parenthood Votes Colorado
lean_basis: Abortion-rights political arm of Planned Parenthood in Colorado. Planned Parenthood Action Fund says the federation works to 'defend reproductive rights' (https://www.plannedparenthoodaction.org/about-us). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: NRA Political Victory Fund
lean_basis: Gun-rights PAC of the National Rifle Association, which calls itself 'a single issue organization' that grades candidates on 'Second Amendment issues' (https://www.nrapvf.org/). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Rocky Mountain Gun Owners
lean_basis: Gun-rights group that says it has 'led the charge to halt the radical anti-gun agenda across Colorado' (https://rmgo.org/about-us/). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Colorado Chamber of Commerce PAC
lean_basis: Statewide chamber of commerce that calls itself 'a unifying voice for business' and works to 'strengthen Colorado’s business climate' (https://cochamber.com/about/). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Colorado Fraternal Order of Police
lean_basis: Police union that calls itself 'The Voice For Colorado Law Enforcement' (https://coloradofop.org/), with no ideological language. No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.
